PD-0147.prompt: Real CCTV traffic camera recording: grainy surveillance video from a fixed camera on a pole, locked-off static shot, the camera never moves, pans or zooms. Ordinary real-time traffic speed, no slow motion, no cuts. Overcast suburban London crossroads. The main-road traffic lights stay red the whole time and a dark grey car waits at them. A blue hatchback drives out of the side road on the left and crosses the junction on its green light. A red hatchback comes down the main road from the distance, goes past the waiting grey car, runs the red light and crashes into the front of the blue car in the middle of the junction. Glass and plastic scatter and both cars stop nose to nose.
